paragraphs: Bangor University is a public research university located in Bangor, on the north coast of Wales — between Snowdonia mountains and the Menai Strait. Founded in 1884, Bangor is known for Marine Biology and Ocean Sciences (#1 in UK), Psychology, Business (Bangor Business School — AACSB accredited), and Welsh-language degrees. The compact campus sits in a UNESCO World Heritage area, with one of the lowest costs of living among UK universities.
International students enter via Oxford International pathway programmes — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead into Bangor Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
paragraphsRu: Bangor University — государственный исследовательский университет в Бангоре, на северном побережье Уэльса, между горами Snowdonia и проливом Menai. Основан в 1884 году. Известен Marine Biology и Ocean Sciences (#1 в UK), психологией, бизнесом (Bangor Business School — AACSB), уэльско-язычными программами. Компактный кампус в UNESCO World Heritage area — одна из самых низких стоимостей жизни среди UK университетов.
Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Bangor.
